products.product: Prices orders from stitch count, digitizing, blanks, thread, hooping, machine time, spoilage, setup, and rush capacity.

products.valueProposition: Calculates an order floor and learns realistic production time by garment and design type.
products.startupCost: Solo MVP: web app, CSV import, managed database, and optional read-only integrations.
products.seoAngle: Targets purchase and problem-aware searches including: embroidery pricing calculator; embroidery estimating software; embroidery shop job costing; embroidery pricing and order profitability software; embroidery pricing and order profitability calculator; embroidery pricing and order profitability pricing
products.seoThesis: A narrow site for custom embroidery and decorated-apparel shops can connect commercial pages, calculators, comparisons, and implementation guides around embroidery pricing and order profitability to the same measurable margin outcome.
